um_version: On The Rocks! v1.6 Testing v6.0.3.9
conditions_and_limits: One-use offline worlds; no player save touched. Source data frozen before tests.
Lua samples report natural heap and full-GC heap separately; full GC affects timing. Process private memory is distinct from Lua heap.
Recursion failure requires synthetic occupied candidate regions; the affected world was not supplied.
Air actor is a spawned Wilson in a clientless dedicated server; real-client active-area timing not verified.
Fresh cave test used a standalone cave preset; no actual multi-shard migration tested.
GPS save actor has no real-client map handshake; explored old-world/map-heavy/inventory-heavy saves not covered.
No x86/32-bit comparison and no actual failing user save; cannot identify the screenshot allocation call site.
One parallel test restart collided with another isolated server port; excluded as product failure and repeated serially.
Owned process observation guard 3 GiB private bytes; never hit. No forced huge allocation or changed allocator used.

isolated_lua_recursion.conditions: Synthetic all-blocked candidates; actual component, no production fixes. 256 MiB Lua safety cap and 2 second instruction-time budget.
